CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Songs.
   C. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Songs.

9. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

10. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)

----
